name: Import footage
description: Imports a footage folder, mirroring its folder tree as bins. Video and audio only; a RED .RDC folder becomes one clip (first .R3D) with its wav in the same bin; Exports/Renders/Proxies/cache folders are skipped; files already in the project are skipped. Optionally makes one linked R3D+wav sequence per RED clip with a wav, in a Synced bin (Premiere cannot script Merge Clips). Preview shows the plan without importing.
